scope: Orléans 2014 dlp base game, 2–4 players; English booklet pp.12–21, base Place Tiles pp.22–23, components p.24. Excludes optional Place Tile exclusion and expansions.

grading_standard.correct: Every requested material fact correct and supported; no contradictory/unresolved ruling.
grading_standard.partial: At least one missing/unresolved requested fact, no material contradiction.
grading_standard.incorrect: At least one material source contradiction.
grading_standard.support: Unsupported correct guesses flagged separately and do not satisfy completion.

answers.expected_answer: No one gains for a tied lead; the unique last player pays 1 coin. With 2 players, unique leader gains 1 coin and last pays nothing.
answers.novelty: Census ties and two-player exception

answers.expected_answer: Drawing is optional up to the Knight allowance and free Market capacity; draw at most two. Unused Market Followers remain and occupy spaces.
answers.novelty: Draw allowance versus capacity and retention

answers.expected_answer: May fill over rounds, cannot execute until all required spaces occupied. May save activation with tiles left in place. On execution Followers go to own bag; Technology stays.
answers.novelty: Partial/full activation and destinations

answers.expected_answer: Start player then clockwise, one action or pass per turn, repeat until all pass. Passing ends own actions this round even if activated actions remain; unused activation and Followers stay for a later round.
answers.novelty: Action turn cycle and irreversible pass

answers.expected_answer: Take Farmer into own bag; advance Farmer track one space and take depicted good.
answers.novelty: Farm House effect

answers.expected_answer: Choose Boatman, Craftsman or Trader, put recruit in bag and advance corresponding track. Boatman gains depicted coins (first at last space gets Citizen instead); Craftsman gains Technology usable only after passing; Trader gains Place Tile.
answers.novelty: Village choices and rewards

answers.expected_answer: Only use after passing, so no further own action this round. First must replace Farmer; later any required Character except Monk. Max one per Place, no single-Character Places, cannot move after placement; remains until game end.
answers.novelty: Technology timing and restrictions

answers.expected_answer: First advance category I only; later I or II. Place beside board; can activate/use ability; stacks inspectable at any time.
answers.novelty: Place acquisition categories and access

answers.expected_answer: University Scholar into bag, advance Scholars and gain depicted Development Points; Castle Knight into bag, advance Knights for draw limit; fourth Knight stays draw 7, first there may take Citizen. Monastery Monk into bag, no additional bonus. At final track space cannot take corresponding action again.
answers.novelty: Other recruitment and final track boundaries

answers.expected_answer: Monk may replace Knight or any other Character in ordinary actions. No other Character or Technology can replace required Monk. Beneficial Deeds require exact depicted types, no Monk substitution.
answers.novelty: Wild substitution exceptions

answers.expected_answer: Ship moves to one adjacent town along Waterway; Wagon likewise along Road. May take one good from connection even if multiple; keep by board. Empty links legal, give no good.
answers.novelty: Movement scope and goods selection

answers.expected_answer: Build Trading Station in Merchant current town; no existing station of any player allowed. In Orléans each player may build one.
answers.novelty: Station construction and exception

answers.expected_answer: Scriptorium gives 1 Development Point/advance 1 space. Landing/passing coin gives depicted coins; first landing/passing Citizen gets it. Landing/passing status immediately sets Development Status to shown value (initially 1).
answers.novelty: Development action and crossing rewards

answers.expected_answer: One or two can activate, move one or both to free matching Deed spaces; colored starters prohibited. Receive depicted 1/2/3 coins per tile; Canalization 1 coin or 1 Development Point. Tile remains permanently. Completing last vacant Deed space earns its Citizen.
answers.novelty: Town Hall routing, rewards and completion

answers.expected_answer: Pilgrimage forbids recruiting Monks during Phase 5 Actions. Other events resolve Phase 6. Pilgrimage is deliberately first/top tile.
answers.novelty: Event timing exception

answers.expected_answer: Grain/cheese/wine qualify, wool does not. Must pay one food to Goods Market; if no food pay 5 coins, if unable undergo torture for missing coins.
answers.novelty: Harvest food, fallback, destination

answers.expected_answer: Neutral Scholar returned to game board, available again; do not move Scholar track backward. Colored starter cannot be lost; keep it and lose no tile this round, no redraw.
answers.novelty: Plague neutral/marked branches

answers.expected_answer: Pay available coin and replace each missing coin (two) with one item, any mix: built/supply Trading Station, random bag Follower (redraw colored starters), Development Point (left one, never onto/past coin space), Goods, Place, Technology. Remove items from game, only Development Points can be regained.
answers.novelty: Bankruptcy payments and irreversible loss

answers.expected_answer: Tiles limited: cannot play action providing unavailable tile. Harvest/Plague can return stock, permitting actions again. With insufficient supply coins, players cannot receive coins at that moment.
answers.novelty: Exhaustion and restored availability

answers.expected_answer: Tied most stations gives no bonus Citizen. Grain 1, cheese 2, wine 3, wool 4, brocade 5; coins 1 VP each; (built stations + collected Citizens) × Development Status. Highest VP; tie furthest ahead on Development Track; still tied share win.
answers.novelty: End bonus, complete scoring and tiebreak

answers.expected_answer: Each gets board, bag, Merchant, 10 stations, 5 coins, 7 markers and colored Farmer/Boatman/Craftsman/Trader. Starting Followers on Market, Merchant in Orléans, markers at first spaces of six Character Tracks and Development Track; stations/coins in front of player. Youngest starts.
answers.novelty: Initial availability and board/personal placement

answers.expected_answer: 13 Citizens on marked main/Deed board spaces, remaining Citizen aside. Technology supply on board; neutral Followers sorted by profession in buildings. Places sorted I/II. Shuffle goods face down, put one face up per Road/Waterway goods space, sort leftovers face up to Goods Market.
answers.novelty: Shared setup, market versus map destinations

answers.expected_answer: 3 players remove 2 each Farmer/Boatman/Craftsman/Trader, 3 each Knight/Scholar/Monk, 6 random goods; leave 4 spaces empty. 2 players remove 4 each first four types, 6 each last three, 12 random goods; leave 3/4 spaces empty. Remove unused colors starting Followers.
answers.novelty: Player-count-dependent supply and map setup

answers.expected_answer: Farm House Boatman+Craftsman; Village Farmer+Boatman+Craftsman; University Farmer+Craftsman+Trader; Castle Farmer+Boatman+Trader; Monastery Scholar+Trader.
source_references: PDF p.12 player-board illustration (player-board-costs-p12.png); p.15 example lines176–177
answers.novelty: Printed recruitment activation costs omitted from prose extraction

answers.expected_answer: Ship Farmer+Boatman+Knight; Wagon Farmer+Trader+Knight; Guildhall Farmer+Craftsman+Knight.
answers.novelty: Printed travel and construction activation costs

answers.expected_answer: Scriptorium Knight+Scholar. Town Hall one or two neutral Followers of any profession, but no colored starting Followers; Deed destinations must match exact depicted professions.
source_references: PDF p.12 player-board illustration; p.18 lines279–296
answers.novelty: Printed Development activation and generic Town Hall slots

answers.expected_answer: Yes: draw four and recover two assigned Followers into Market (subject to space). One recovery per declined draw in Phase3; cannot transfer directly between Action Spaces.
answers.novelty: Recovery timing and direct-transfer prohibition

answers.expected_answer: May inspect bag at any time for number/types, then shuffle so draws cannot be chosen deliberately.
answers.novelty: Private bag inspection and randomized draws

answers.expected_answer: Hour Glass, Census, Followers, Planning, Actions, Event, Start Player. Token to player left. Start planning simultaneously; announce completion; if needed clockwise from Start Player; payments same order. Coins paid to/received from common supply.
answers.novelty: Phase sequence, simultaneous planning and payment priority

answers.expected_answer: Complete that entire round, including actions and event; then final Trading Station Citizen award and scoring.
answers.novelty: Final-round end trigger and remaining phases

answers.expected_answer: Use Farmers Track marker position, not physical tiles currently owned/in bag. Unique track leader gains 1 coin.
answers.novelty: Track state versus current Follower ownership

answers.expected_answer: Coins equal to current Development Status, not raw position counted as Development Points.
answers.novelty: Income event value basis

answers.expected_answer: Pay 2 coins, one per complete group of three goods regardless of type; shortage triggers torture for missing coins.
answers.novelty: Taxes complete-group rounding and payment failure

answers.expected_answer: 4 coins, one per built Trading Station; unbuilt stations do not count.
answers.novelty: Trading Day built-only income

answers.expected_answer: Hayrick Farmer→grain; Cheese Factory two Farmers→cheese; Winery Farmer+Trader→wine; Wool Manufacturer Boatman+Trader→wool; Tailor Shop Scholar+Trader→brocade. Each takes one from Goods Market, and cannot be used if that type absent.
answers.novelty: Five base production Places, costs and local exhaustion

answers.expected_answer: Shipping Line Boatman:1 Development Point. Brewery Monk:2 coins. Windmill two Craftsmen:2 coins plus1 Development Point. Library Knight+Scholar:2 Development Points.
answers.novelty: Distinct printed base development/coin Place effects

answers.expected_answer: Any one Character can activate. Spend1–3 coins for equal Development spaces; two coins moves2. Cannot spend zero or four.
answers.novelty: Flexible activation with bounded voluntary payment

answers.expected_answer: Cellar Monk+Scholar:4 coins. Office two Scholars:1 coin per built station. Hospital Boatman+Scholar:coins equal current Development Status.
answers.novelty: Fixed versus built-station and Development-Status Place income

answers.expected_answer: Trader+Knight. Merchant moves along one Road to adjacent town and collects one good if available.
source_references: PDF p.23 Horse Wagon illustration; lines531–539
answers.novelty: Alternative road action with its distinct cost

answers.expected_answer: Scholar+Craftsman; gives Technology under usual constraints. First must replace Farmer, which Laboratory lacks, so first cannot go there. Later can replace Scholar or Craftsman there if no existing Technology (not Monk; max one per Place).
source_references: PDF p.23 Laboratory illustration; lines480–486; p.16 lines209–218
answers.novelty: Laboratory acquisition and first-tile placement interaction

answers.expected_answer: Farmer activates. Draw3 bag Followers, choose2, immediately place on matching Action Spaces; none on Bathhouse. Third drawn and activating Farmer return to bag.
answers.novelty: Original-edition Bathhouse immediate placement and destinations

answers.expected_answer: Place the one immediately; return other two and activating Follower to bag. If none fit, place none and return all three plus activating Follower. Never place Bathhouse draws on Bathhouse.
answers.novelty: Bathhouse insufficient-placement branch

answers.expected_answer: May execute on a later own action turn this round: Bathhouse places immediately, and full activation allows action during current/future Action Phase; no extra Planning Phase required. Cannot act after passing.
answers.novelty: Bathhouse changes activation during Actions rather than Planning

answers.expected_answer: A Monk activates. During Event Phase return Monk to bag instead of suffering current negative event such as Harvest, Taxes or Plague.
answers.novelty: Sacristy event-phase consumption/protection

answers.expected_answer: No. Pilgrimage forbids Monk recruitment in Phase5 Actions. Sacristy substitutes for negative effects during Phase6 Event and cannot cancel that earlier prohibition.
answers.novelty: Sacristy protection timing versus exceptional Pilgrimage timing

answers.expected_answer: Ongoing ability, no activation: Boatmen replace Craftsmen, Traders and Farmers only. Does not permit Boatmen to replace Knights, Scholars or Monks.
source_references: PDF p.23 Herb Garden tile; lines506–513
answers.novelty: Herb Garden exact substitution set

answers.expected_answer: Ongoing no-activation ability: Scholars may replace other Character types except Monks. Cannot replace Monk.
answers.novelty: School ongoing substitution and Monk exception

answers.expected_answer: No: Deeds always require exact depicted types regardless of substitution abilities or route through Town Hall/Tower.
answers.novelty: Global exact-type exception overrides acquired substitution/routing abilities

answers.expected_answer: Adds2 Market spaces; put1/2 drawn Followers there in Phase3. In Planning move one/both onto Action Spaces, or during Actions send one/both directly to matching Deed spaces in a single action. Cannot send colored starting Followers to Deeds.
answers.novelty: Tower capacity, dual timing and direct Deed action

answers.expected_answer: Unique leader gains1 coin. Neither tied-last player pays.
answers.novelty: Separate tied-minimum Census outcome not in Q01 scenario

answers.expected_answer: Before final scoring, the unique player with the most built Trading Stations receives the remaining Citizen Tile. It is one of that player’s collected Citizens and scores that player’s Development Status, like the others.
answers.novelty: New source-defined unique-most award branch; current Q20 tests tied-most/no award only. Scoring clause makes the consequence concrete; it is supporting context rather than an additional claimed novelty.

answers.expected_answer: Set aside the lighter-hued Pilgrimage Tile, shuffle the remaining Hour Glass Tiles, place the shuffled stack face down on its game-board space, and put that Pilgrimage Tile on top. In Phase 1 the Start Player draws the topmost tile and turns it face up.
answers.novelty: New randomization/orientation/reveal procedure; fixed-first event overlaps Q15 as necessary context but the question is not another first-event question.

answers.expected_answer: Each coin is worth 1 victory point.
answers.novelty: Coin VP is an independent scoring source. Q20 key mentions it incidentally, but its prompt does not ask for it; independent review clarified not to grade unrequested facts as required.

answers.expected_answer: Initial Development Status is1; initial Knight draw allowance is4 Followers (subject to free Market capacity).
answers.novelty: Tests the initial Development Status branch before a later threshold is reached; earlier questions test changes and current Status-based rewards. Starting Knight allowance is supporting initial-state context.

answers.expected_answer: Only lost Development Points can be regained. All surrendered physical items are removed from game, not returned to supplies, so cannot become available there again through normal return effects.
answers.novelty: Explicit recovery exception for Development Points; Q18 asks payment/destinations, and independent adjudication treated later Development recovery as incidental rather than a requested part.

answers.expected_answer: You may carry out your activated actions in any order, while still taking only one action on each of your turns in the clockwise Action Phase.
source_references: p15, authoritative-source.txt line167: explicit any-order permission; lines162–163: existing one-action turn rule.
answers.novelty: New explicit procedural permission. Q04 concerns order among players and irreversible passing; it does not ask order among one player’s activated Places. This is a direct rule question, not changed numbers or recombined action effects.

answers.expected_answer: It is available as soon as you acquire the Place. The acquired Place is now available to use its special ability; these passive abilities do not require activation or a next-round delay.
source_references: p17, authoritative-source.txt lines232–234: place the chosen Place beside the board; you now have a Place to activate or use its special ability.
p23, authoritative-source.txt lines506–513 and523–530, and tile illustrations: Herb Garden and School ownership abilities.
answers.novelty: Consequential acquisition-timing rule, directly grounded in the source’s now-available instruction. Q08 asks permitted categories and inspecting stacks; Q46/Q47 test substitution scope for owned Places. None asks when ownership starts conferring the passive effect. No separate question is proposed for every possible later action or substituted profession.
